g.title: BULKHEAD_A_CABIN
g.text: Maven / Deutsch HD30 shell-size-24 35-way flange receptacle
Connector A cabin side — permanent. 8HP + accessories + WBO2 + boost solenoid + APS.

Connector A is permanent — never disconnected at M52→07K swap. Engine-side of this connector also stays connected; the 8HP TCU, WBO2 sensor, and boost solenoid do not move at engine swap time. APS pins A14–A19 are cavity-plugged in Phase 1 (M52); the cabin-side cable run (E46 pedal → A cabin face) is the one cabin-side harness addition at Phase 3.
HD30 24-35 CONTACT SIZE CONSTRAINT (source: Deutsch HD30 and HDP20 Technical Manual, Ed.2007, p.9):
The 24-35 insert contains only size-16 (13A max) and size-20 (7.5A max) contacts.
Size-16 positions: 4 (inner ring ~6 o'clock), 7 (middle ring 12 o'clock), 12 (middle ring ~4 o'clock).
All other positions are size-20. There are NO size-12 or size-8 positions in this insert.
⚠️ High-current relay outputs (fan, EWP, AC) CANNOT route through this connector.
⚠️ Route +12V Fan, +12V Cond Fan, +12V EWP, +12V AC through dedicated bulkhead fittings.
Recommended: Deutsch DT 2-pin connectors (each rated for 25A with 12 AWG contact)
or a single DT 4-pin through a separate weatherproof grommet nearby.
Size-16 positions assigned: A1 (+12V 8HP Main) → position 4;
A3 (8HP TCU GND) → position 7; A8 (Chassis GND) → position 12.

CAN H/L (A4/A5) must be twisted pair. 120Ω termination at MaxxECU end (cabin) and at 8HP TCU end (engine bay). DCTShifter and Gauge.S tap cabin-side CAN bus before the bulkhead — no extra pins needed.

g.title: W_BULKHEAD_A
g.text: BULKHEAD_A_ENGINE:20:Boost solenoid → firewall bracket Superseal pin 2

CAN H/L (A4/A5) must be twisted pair. 120Ω at MaxxECU end and 8HP TCU end. APS wires (A14–A19) are added at Phase 3 as a separate cabin cable run (pedal → Connector A cabin face, ~0.8m, 24 AWG shielded 6-conductor). WBO2 bundle: shielded 5-conductor preferred. Drain at MaxxECU end only. HIGH-CURRENT lines bypassed: +12V Fan/Cond Fan/EWP/AC relay each route through their own Deutsch DT 2-pin connector via a separate grommet. Crimp 12 AWG contacts for fan relays; 10 AWG for EWP. DT 2-pin rated 25A/contact — use 2× in parallel for EWP (2x25A = 50A combined, exceeds 36A max draw).

g.title: BULKHEAD_A_ENGINE
g.text: Maven / Deutsch HD30 shell-size-24 35-way jam nut plug
Connector A engine side — permanent (never swapped).
Boost solenoid → firewall bracket Superseal pin 2

Connector A engine side is permanent — never replaced. WBO2 Heater+ (LSU 4.9 pin 4): splice locally to AS79 engine-connector +12V coil/inj rail. HIGH-CURRENT BYPASS: +12V Fan, +12V Cond Fan, +12V EWP (CWA400 36A max), +12V AC relay out do NOT pass through this connector — route via dedicated Deutsch DT 2-pin connectors through separate grommet alongside bulkhead plate. Physical contact positions 4, 7, 12 are size-16 (13A max) — all sufficient for 8HP power, TCU GND, and chassis GND at their actual load.

g.title: BULKHEAD_B_CABIN
g.text: Maven / Deutsch HD30 shell-size-24 47-way flange receptacle
Connector B cabin side — permanent. Engine control signals.
SPARE (boost solenoid → Connector A pin A24)

Connector B cabin side is permanent (never disconnected). Engine-side mating plug swaps at M52→07K: M52 plug populates B1–B36 (B8/B14/B31–B33 on M52 mating plug; B37–B46 cavity-plugged). 07K plug populates B1–B7, B9–B13, B15–B19 cavity-plugged (07K uses B39–B40 for its own cam/crank CMC inputs), B20–B30, B34–B36, B37–B46. WBO2 Heater+ (LSU 4.9 pin 4) splices locally to +12V coil/inj rail (B1) on the engine side — no dedicated bulkhead pin needed. Crank VR+/−/shield (B15–B17) must be shielded twisted pair; shield terminates at cabin-side sensor GND (CMC H1), floating at engine side. 07K cam signal type (B39): verify at install whether the 07K Hall sensor is +5V or +12V type. If +5V and it cannot share B23 (CMC G1), migrate to Connector A spare A25 and pair with Sensor GND 2 on A26. Update mating plug accordingly. B47 is the only true spare cavity. Any additional signal discovered mid-build must either share an existing GND/5V rail (check load budgets) or overflow to Connector A spares A24–A29.

g.title: W_BULKHEAD_B
g.text: BULKHEAD_B_ENGINE_M52:1:+12V Coils/Inj → engine harness common rail
BULKHEAD_B_ENGINE_M52:15:Crank VR+ → M52 crank sensor pin 1
BULKHEAD_B_ENGINE_M52:16:Crank VR- → M52 crank sensor pin 2

07K phase expansion wires (B37–B46) are added at Phase 3 as part of the 07K engine-side mating plug build. The cabin-side connectors (BULKHEAD_B_CABIN) are pre-wired to those cavities at initial build — only the engine-side plug changes. Crank VR+/−/shield (B15–B17): shielded twisted pair. Shield terminates at cabin-side CMC H1 (sensor GND), floating at engine side. Keep this sub-loom away from injector/coil wires per isolation rule in loom-routing.md.

g.title: BULKHEAD_B_ENGINE_M52
g.text: Maven / Deutsch HD30 shell-size-24 47-way jam nut plug
Connector B engine side — M52 Phase 1. Unplugs at 07K swap.
Crank VR+ → M52 crank sensor pin 1
Crank VR- → M52 crank sensor pin 2
SPARE — cavity plug (boost solenoid on Connector A)

M52 Phase 1 engine-side plug. 36 active wires (B1–B36, minus B19 spare). B37–B47 cavity-plugged. At 07K swap: unplug this, build and install 07K Phase 3 plug. Connector A engine side stays connected throughout — do not unplug. 07K PHASE 3 PLUG PINOUT (not modelled as WireViz connector — describe at build time):
B20–B23: same (sensor GND, CLT, IAT, +5V — verify 07K cam Hall shares G1 5V ref).
B24: cavity-plug (M52 TPS; 07K TB TPS → B41 DBW set).
B25–B29: same (MAP, PST pres, PST temp, flex sig, flex +12V).
B30: SPARE on both M52 and 07K plugs (boost solenoid moved to Connector A pin A24).
B31–B33: cavity-plug (VANOS, ICV A/B — 07K has none).
B34–B36: same (starter, alt D+, AIN2 stub).
B39: 07K cam signal (confirm CMC pin — different type from M52 Hall).
B41: DBW TB signal → TB TPS output.
B42: DBW TB +5V → TB sensor supply.
B43: DBW TB GND → TB sensor GND.

Cam sensor note: if 07K cam Hall is +5V type and cannot share B23 (CMC G1), migrate to Connector A A25 (+5V-2) / A26 (SGND-2). DBW TB motor +/− stay on engine side (H-bridge engine-bay mounted) — do not cross bulkhead. WBO2 Heater+ (LSU 4.9 pin 4): splice to +12V coil/inj rail at B1 on engine side.
